messages:
maria: Trying to spin up a 50-GPU preemptible job in us-west2 for a perf benchmark, but getting quota errors. project: redwood-prod-01. Anyone can open a GCP quota case?

josh: How many A100 GPUs are currently allocated in that project? If it's an org-level quota we need to request there.

maria: Error when launching:
```
ERROR: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for region 'us-west2'.
Requested: 50 x A100-40GB (preemptible)
Available: 8
```
I opened a support ticket: Case 194-CASE-837264 (submitted with justification, target run window 2026-03-22 UTC).

devops-bot: Ticket 194-CASE-837264 created by maria. Reminder: please attach project number and billing account.

GCP Support: Thanks — we have the case. Please provide the project numeric ID and billing account; for >24 GPUs escalation requires org admin approval. If you confirm, we'll escalate to the capacity team (ESCL-4472).

li: If this run is time-sensitive, we should quantify cost of alternative: splitting into 2 regions or smaller batches. Any estimate?

josh: Back-of-envelope: 50 x A100-preemptible x 12h ≈ $6,500. If we split to 2 regions might increase overhead but lower wait time. Recommend requesting us-west2 first, parallel fallback to us-central1.

maria: Project number: 987654321098. Billing account: BAC-0123-4567. SKU we requested: `A100_40GB_PREEMPTIBLE` — added to case notes.

GCP Support: Escalated to capacity team (ESCL-4472). Estimated response 24–36 hrs. Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/194-CASE-837264

ops-sre: On our side I'll stage a fallback launch template for us-central1 with 20 GPUs and implement queue backoff so the job can resume if capacity arrives. @maria I'll patch the run config.

maria: Thanks — pausing the full 50-GPU run until we hear back. I'll try a shorter 8-GPU test in us-central1 as a warmup. Will report updates here. :thumbsup:
